div.head: Wl art Inscr.
div.ab: Hic intimatur quid Willelmus rex Anglorum cum principibus suis constituit post conquisitionem Angliae.
Intimation is hereby given of the enactments made by William, King of England, and his magnates after he had obtained possession of England.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.
